_about: Every fix that has been undone once by an old copy of a file goes here. scripts/regression-guard.js fails (CI, before every OTA, before every deploy) if the text is gone (must_contain) or has come back (must_not_contain). Add an entry in the SAME commit as the fix. If you remove a fix on purpose, change the entry in that commit and say why.

explicit line heights in the booking detail header
customer cancelled / not there goes to the office as a no-show request, not a penalised cancel

drivers can send a screenshot to Support
